notes.title: The Moroccan Castle 3 : Behind The Secrets Update is Available Now !
notes.content:
Hello , Thanks for playing [b]The Moroccan Castle 3 : Behind The Secrets [/b]

This [b]Update[/b] is a regular update for fixing some bugs and improving the Game with some new things !

[b]In this Update :[/b]

- Optimized the game for low Specs 
- FIxed some lighting issued 
- Decreased the jump height 
- Fixed some movement bugs and Issues 
- Added Objective System , Helping the players to know what they should do ( and Soon I will add the achievement system )
- Changed the UI Main Color from white to dark
- Added Floating Icons to objects 
- Fixed the bug that player can be stuck in some places 
- FIxed the bug that you can see the player head when crouching 
- Fixed the bug that player can heal with the " Bloodbag " and can't use it for the Blood Puzzle
- Removed the prone mechanic , and changed the Crouch from Control key to C key 
- Added some new Jumpscare in The Game 
- Changed some Sounds and Lights 
- Removed the last scene ( Driving back scene ) because of the freeze can get in this scene 

and Thank you again for playing The Moroccan Castle 3  !

notes.title: THE MOROCCAN CASTLE 3 RELEASE DAY
notes.content:
To all those who are considering buying the game, get ready for a thrilling and chilling experience. Your nerves will be tested as you explore the dark and eerie world that you have crafted. With a captivating storyline and haunting sound effects, you will be drawn into a world of horror that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very end.

For those who have already bought the game, get ready to immerse yourself in an experience like no other. Explore every nook and cranny of the game world, unravel the mysteries and secrets hidden within, and try to survive the terrifying encounters that lie ahead.

Remember, this is not a game for the faint of heart. If you are easily frightened or have a weak constitution, you may want to think twice before diving into this horror experience. But for those brave enough to face the horrors that await, prepare for an unforgettable experience that will leave you feeling both scared and exhilarated.

So go ahead and dive in. Buy the game, play it, and get ready to be scared out of your wits. We guarantee that you won't be disappointed.
